verdict.rationale: Secureframe's docs describe running access reviews directly in the platform, pulling user data from native and custom integrations or CSV. They also cover designating reviewers per system on recurring schedules with reminders, having reviewers decide in-app whether to maintain, modify, revoke or scope out access, and generating follow-up tasks that sync to ticketing. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence that the completed review artifact is stored in an evidence library for auditors, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the workflow.
